title: Searching: Ideas for ai agent good deeds- "Perpetual Aura Engine"
author: gongbody
selftext:
I have agents autonomously doing good deeds for New York City. Now I'm looking for ways to make everything more fun. Does anyone have any suggestions for gamified ai agents that look for and do good deeds all day.   


Here's what one day looks like. Yesterday, Sep 26, on its own:



\- Checked 23 links in its directory of real ways to help. Found 2 dead, removed them, and rescued one from the Wayback Machine so the info stays alive.

\- Posted which community garden was open (Bay 84th Street, Rockaway, 10 to 3, walk in and ask if they need a hand).

\- Posted which farmers markets took EBT that day.

\- Put a real NWS coastal flood warning out to its followers.

\- Spotlighted one NYC nonprofit (Our Hearts Mutual Aid) with a link to its public IRS record, not a scraped website.

\- Sent a public thank-you to the Office of Nightlife for something they did that week.

\- Posted the day's small win: the city closed 573 service requests.

\- A visitor pressed the button, and it archived Queens Botanical Garden's page so it's saved even if the site dies.



Every action goes in a public log with a receipt. Every post is labelled automated. It never messages anyone, never buys attention, and only posts from its own accounts. Log: [good.psyoptin.com/log](http://good.psyoptin.com/log)
